content.title: About
content.content: Oat milk is a plant‑based beverage made from whole oat grains and water. It is unsweetened, plain, and sold refrigerated, offering a mild, slightly nutty flavor. Oat milk is commonly used as a dairy milk alternative in coffee, cereals, baking, and sauces.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Oat milk contains beta‑glucans, which can help lower cholesterol levels.
Unlike many plant drinks, oat milk naturally foams well, making it popular for coffee drinks.
Oats are one of the most environmentally friendly crops, requiring less water and land than dairy production.
Unsweetened oat milk is suitable for people watching sugar intake and for diabetics when consumed in moderation.
Commercial oat milk is often fortified with calcium, vitamin D, and B12 to match dairy milk’s nutrient profile.

items.title: Rich in beta‑glucans
items.content: Beta‑glucans support healthy cholesterol levels and aid immune function.

items.title: Source of plant protein
items.content: Oat milk provides a modest amount of protein that can complement a vegan diet.

items.title: Contains iron and vitamin B1
items.content: These micronutrients help with energy metabolism and nervous system health.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Makes it suitable for heart‑healthy eating patterns.

items.title: Fortified with calcium
items.content: Added calcium supports bone and teeth health.

items.title: Oat allergy
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to oats or the gluten they contain.

items.title: Added sugars in flavored versions
items.content: While the unsweetened version is safe, flavored oat milks can contain added sugars.

items.title: Phytic acid content
items.content: Phytic acid may reduce the absorption of certain minerals if consumed in large amounts.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Drink it plain, add to coffee, tea, smoothies, cereals, baked goods, sauces, and soups. It is also used in vegan desserts and as a base for plant‑based yogurts.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at 1‑4 °C. Once opened, consume within 7‑10 days. Do not leave at room temperature for more than 2 hours. Discard if it develops a sour smell or off‑color.
